meta.name: improve-retention
meta.description: Diagnose and fix retention problems using behavior design (B=MAP). Use when the user mentions "users sign up but dont stick around", "activation rate", "onboarding friction", "retention metrics", "why users dont complete", "churn analysis", or "aha moment". Also trigger when analyzing cohort retention curves, designing activation milestones, reducing time-to-value for new users, or investigating why users quit after their first session. Covers the Ability Chain, prompt design, and tiny behaviors that compound. For habit loops and variable rewards, see hooked-ux. For intrinsic motivation, see drive-motivation.

copy.tagline: 诊断留存问题并用行为设计提升用户粘性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户注册后流失严重，想用行为设计提升留存。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose retention issues and boost user stickiness with behavior design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users sign up but don't stick around and you want to improve retention using behavior design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用行为设计模型（B=MAP）诊断留存问题，分析动机、能力、提示三个要素，给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“用户注册了但不活跃”、“激活率”、“留存指标”、“流失分析”等关键词，或要求分析留存曲线、设计激活里程碑时触发。

say.text: 我的新用户激活率只有30%，怎么提高？
say.note: Claude 会分析能力链瓶颈，建议缩小第一步行为。

say.text: 用户第一天后就不来了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检查提示时机和动机波谷。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下这个产品的留存问题。
say.note: Claude 会按六个诊断项评分并指出失败项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the behavior design model (B=MAP) to diagnose retention problems, analyzing motivation, ability, and prompts, then provides a score and improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "users sign up but don't stick around", "activation rate", "retention metrics", "churn analysis", or ask to analyze retention curves or design activation milestones.

say_en.text: My new user activation rate is only 30%, how to improve?
Users drop off after day one, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will check prompt timing and motivation troughs.

say_en.text: Help me diagnose the retention problem of this product.
say_en.note: Claude will score against six diagnostic items and point out failing rows.
